title: evidence receipt
description: One verdict, pinned: what ran, against what, and what it said. Receipts hash-chain per suite so the evidence trail is tamper-evident; an optional signer can countersign self_sha256 later — the receipt defines fields, never a signature scheme. Fields are settled in Phase 0 so early runs emit receipt-shaped records before anything signs them.

detail.description: The probe's one RED line of truth (or tail).

probe_sha256.description: Hash of the probe executable that produced the verdict.

kind.description: git: commit hash of the target tree. content: digest of the artifact(s) the probe read.

oracle_versions.description: Pinned oracle versions the verdict compared against (from the suite's versions.lock).

prev.description: self_sha256 of the previous receipt in this suite's chain; null for the first.

self_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of this receipt with self_sha256/signature/signer/signer_fields absent.

signature.description: Optional countersignature over self_sha256, produced by the project's pluggable signer. recurve defines the receipt, never the signature scheme.

signer_fields.description: Optional annotations the signer added alongside the signature (e.g. signer_did, envelope_ref). Excluded from self_sha256 — the signer runs after the hash is fixed.
